teach_faq: iPhone transfers stop on large files
A browser memory limit. Use a computer for files over 1 GB, or send them in batches.
Office or school Wi-Fi won't connect
That network uses AP isolation, so the two devices can't see each other. Turn on one phone's hotspot and connect both devices to it.
Download them to the device first (Photos will show them as downloaded), then select them here.
We list exactly what the platform offers — up to 8K. If a video only has one quality, that's the only option.

tr_steps_sum: How to use: send files to another device (tap to open)
tr_step1: Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi (a phone hotspot for the computer is fine).
tr_step2: Pick which device receives: on that one tap Generate my code - a 6-digit number appears.
tr_step3: On the other device (the sender) type those 6 digits in the pairing box and tap Pair.
tr_step4: When paired, This device and Other device both show a green dot.
tr_step5: Tap Photos / Files / Folder to choose what to send (on desktop you can drag files or a whole folder in).
tr_step6: Tap Send and wait for the progress to finish. Stay on this page - do not close it or switch apps.
tr_step7: The other device saves automatically (iPhone shows Save to Photos, Android saves to Downloads).
tr_step8: Transfer has its own free quota, counted separately from downloads (each has its own daily allowance); paid members are unlimited.
tr_steps_note: Files never pass through our server, are not compressed or converted, and are verified with SHA-256. Keep both devices on this page until it finishes.
m_rules_sum: Levels, benefits and ad rules (tap to open)
m_rule_guest: No sign-up needed, with a daily free quota (resets at 00:00). After 3 uses, the 4th use requires watching an ad; then 3 more uses, and the 7th needs an ad again.
m_rule_free: After signing in your quota follows the account (kept across devices). After 5 uses, the 6th use requires watching an ad; then 5 more uses, and the 11th needs an ad again.
m_rule_monthly: Unlimited and no ads at all. The expiry date is shown above; renewing extends from that date.
m_rule_lifetime: Unlimited, no ads at all, all features free forever.
m_rules_note: Ads are not enabled yet (both ad switches in the admin panel are off by default); the rules above take effect once we connect an ad provider and turn them on. On counting: download and transfer free quotas are separate, but the ad counter combines both (after 3/5 uses in total, the next action needs an ad). A monthly plan that expires without renewal becomes a free member again.
